summary: A copyist model -- reach back into its own text, short reaches slip into one-glyph variants, long reaches copy exactly -- fitted on the 192 public pages to six repetition moments and calibrated to the manuscript's own value of the quantity on public 34-page subsets. Held-out practice: 0.020697 in the band 0.012-0.045, shuffle p = 0.005. Distance-blind copying collapses to 0.00, so the distance profile, not repetition, carries F-021.
